company.name: CoreWeave
company.shortDescription: CoreWeave provides cloud infrastructure services designed to support artificial intelligence and high-performance computing workloads.
company.description: CoreWeave offers GPU-based compute resources, storage, and networking capabilities optimized for training and deploying machine learning models. Its platform includes Kubernetes-based environments, managed software services, and tools for monitoring system performance and cluster health. It enables organizations to run large-scale AI workloads through dedicated infrastructure and configurable deployment options. The company supports developers and enterprises by providing scalable resources aligned with the requirements of data-intensive and compute-intensive applications.
